# FoldTube

> FoldTube is a free, open-source browser extension for Chrome, Brave, Edge and Firefox. One click saves every open YouTube tab (videos, Shorts and live streams) to a private, searchable dashboard and closes the tabs. Everything stays on your device: no account, no servers, no ads, no tracking.

## What it does

- Fold: one click (or a keyboard shortcut) saves and closes every open YouTube video tab. Other tabs, including YouTube's home page, search and playlists, are left alone.
- Resume: opening a saved video picks up where you left off, then clears it from the list. Undo, or restore it from History for 90 days.
- Find: search titles and channels, filter to Videos or Shorts and by length, and sort by date saved, length or title.
- Organize: group by channel with a jump bar, or by Videos and Shorts; grid or list layout; light, dark or system theme.
- Bulk actions: select videos to open or clear several at once.
- Backup: export your list as JSON or an HTML bookmarks page, and import a JSON backup on another computer.

## Install

- [Chrome Web Store (Chrome, Brave, Edge and other Chromium browsers)](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/foldtube-youtube-tab-mana/phkhokoagdgofaaofmecfaibcnnahhoh)
- [Firefox Add-ons (Firefox 142+)](https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/foldtube-youtube-tab-manager/)

## More

- [Privacy policy](https://foldtube.app/privacy.html): what the extension stores and why; nothing leaves your browser.
